title: Trip: misconnect risk (MSP→ORD→SFO)
blurb: A 45-minute ORD connection with delay programs at ORD and SFO.
description: A calendar trip MSP→ORD→SFO with a 45-minute connection at ORD while ORD has a ground delay program (storms) and SFO a flow program for low clouds (ground delay program until 2 PM PT in the ops plan): arrivals at both are held, so the trip shows Delays likely with a missed-connection warning.

assert.re: ^ORD ground delay program: ORD arrivals are held at their departure airports — your .+ MSP→ORD departure may wait ~1 hr 5 min\.$
^Tight connection at ORD: 45 min to make your .+ flight to SFO, and ORD has a ground delay program in effect
^SFO ground delay program: SFO arrivals are held at their departure airports — your .+ ORD→SFO departure may wait ~58 min\.$
